categories.main_business_segments: Novogene Co., Ltd. primarily operates in gene sequencing services, life science basic research services, medical research and technical services, and sequencing platform services. The company also develops and sells clinical gene testing reagents and instruments, focusing on oncology, genetics, and infectious disease clinical testing. Their services include multi-omics integration solutions covering genomics, transcriptomics, epigenomics, microbiomics, spatial transcriptomics, single-cell sequencing, proteomics, and metabolomics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages high-throughput sequencing technologies including second-generation sequencing (NGS), third-generation long-read sequencing (PacBio Revio, Nanopore), and single-cell sequencing platforms. They have developed automated and intelligent production lines such as Falcon, Falcon II, and Falcon III for flexible, high-efficiency sequencing library preparation and data delivery. Their core technologies include de novo sequencing, multi-omics data integration, automated bioinformatics pipelines, and proprietary AI-based bioinformatics tools.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Novogene serves global research universities, scientific research institutes, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, and agricultural enterprises. Their customer base includes over 7,300 clients worldwide, covering top academic institutions and leading pharmaceutical companies. The company targets markets in life sciences research, clinical diagnostics, drug development, and molecular breeding.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global presence with laboratories and subsidiaries in China (Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai, Guangzhou), the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, and the Netherlands. Their business covers six continents and approximately 90 countries and regions, with a strong local presence in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
categories.supply_chain_position: Novogene operates primarily in the midstream segment of the gene sequencing industry supply chain as a gene sequencing service provider. They rely on upstream suppliers for sequencing instruments and reagents, mainly from Illumina and Thermo Fisher, and provide sequencing and bioinformatics services downstream to research and clinical customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in sequencing technologies, multi-omics integration, and automation of sequencing workflows. Strategic R&D focuses include expanding clinical applications of NGS, developing new gene testing reagents and instruments, enhancing bioinformatics automation and AI applications, and advancing single-cell and spatial transcriptomics technologies. They also invest in molecular breeding technologies and maintain a strong patent and software copyright portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Novogene generates revenue primarily through direct sales of gene sequencing services, including multi-omics research services and clinical testing. Additional revenue streams include sales of gene testing reagents, instruments, and consumables. The company employs a direct sales model supported by technical and customer service teams, with some overseas distribution partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Novogene is positioned as a leading gene sequencing service provider in China and globally, competing with companies such as BGI Genomics, Berry Genomics, Burning Rock Medical, and international players like Macrogen. They focus on high-throughput sequencing services for research and clinical markets, with competitive advantages in technology innovation, global localized service networks, and integrated multi-omics solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Novogene reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.11 billion, representing a 5.45% year-over-year growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 196.79 million, up 10.52%. The company maintains a strong asset base with total assets of RMB 3.64 billion and net assets of RMB 2.49 billion. R&D investment accounted for 6.38% of revenue, reflecting a commitment to innovation. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and operational cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Novogene emphasizes its comprehensive, high-throughput sequencing capabilities combined with advanced bioinformatics and multi-omics integration to provide one-stop, high-quality, and efficient gene sequencing solutions. Their global localized laboratory network ensures rapid and stable service delivery. The company differentiates itself through proprietary automation platforms, AI-driven bioinformatics tools, extensive patent portfolio, and a broad product portfolio spanning basic research to clinical applications.
